# JSON manual fixtures

Use Prism Open File in browser or native mode. `generate.py` regenerates the fixtures deterministically. `large.json` is 1,160,571 UTF-8 bytes and contains 90,001 nodes / 10,000 array items; it exercises the worker threshold and virtualized offscreen navigation. `deep.json` has 50 nesting levels. `big-number.json` contains exact unsafe integers, decimals, exponent notation and negative zero. `duplicate-keys.json` retains both name members and nested duplicate x members. `sample.jsonl` is deliberately unsupported as a JSON document; Source remains available. `invalid.json` has a trailing comma; it must expose its original Source and line/column diagnostics without a tree. `unsafe.json` must be text only, including prototype-like keys. No fixture needs external network access.
